mentions.name: 3dpack.ing
mentions.description: An AI-powered 3D container loading tool that calculates optimal ways to load boxes into trucks or containers, taking into account stacking rules, fragility, and real-world constraints. Users can drag boxes like 3D Tetris, upload photos to auto-estimate item dimensions, and use recently added batch-wise guided loading for warehouse use cases. It is monetized via a 14-day free trial with ~$400 MRR.
